source_policy: Only original Dataset300 images and *_CVJsonStd.json; exclude user manual JSON and AI candidate annotations
evaluation_policy: Model and inference choices use validation only. Test is evaluated after choices, not for threshold tuning.

small_comparison.policy: Probe memory first; compare validation under matching training settings, disclose batch differences if memory requires batch 1.
small_comparison.interpretation: Matched first-20-epoch capacity screen; learning-rate schedule matches first20 of Nano80; not a comparison of final convergence limits.

ai_annotation.policy: Original labels are seeds; distinguish conversion from actual visual review and keep change history.
